as_told.title: Mark Felt autobiography: Nixon saw specialized covert technology

plain: Michels says that the former FBI official Mark Felt describes, in a book about his life, President Richard Nixon being shown "pretty specialized covert technology." Michels tells this himself in three episodes, hedging ("I think"). He calls the book a biography in two of them and an autobiography in the third, and once he also mentions the journalist Bob Woodward. If true, it would mean a president was briefed on secret technology of the kind the subject is about.
